name: Triangle-Astérides, centre d'art contemporain
known: Founded by artists between 1992 and 1994 (e-flux directory).
Team: Victorine Grataloup (director), Florence Gosset (administrative and financial director) and Camille Ramanana Rahary (head of exhibitions and residency programmes).
The board is chaired by Marianne Berger-Laleix of the Palais de Tokyo and includes Alice Malinge, Maxime Guitton, Saïd Berkane and the artist Claude Eigan (Triangle-Astérides website).

Ex officio representatives of the public funders also sit on the board: the regional director of cultural affairs, the presidents of the regional council and the departmental council, and the deputy mayor of Marseille for culture (Triangle-Astérides website).

Ulrika Byttner, formerly head of the École supérieure d'art et de design Le Havre-Rouen, named by Minister of Culture Rachida Dati after the board's opinion (Ministry of Culture press release, 19 January 2026).

name: Frac Centre-Val de Loire

name: Bétonsalon – Centre d'art et de recherche
known: Co-founder Mélanie Bouteloup directed it from 2003 until 2020, and Émilie Renard was named director in 2021 (Bétonsalon site).

The site states it has the support of the Ville de Paris, the regional Directorate of Cultural Affairs of Île-de-France (Ministry of Culture) and the Région Île-de-France, in collaboration with Université Paris Cité (stated by the centre).

Its 2018 fifteenth-anniversary press release credits support from Université Paris Diderot - Paris 7, the regional cultural affairs directorate, the Île-de-France Region and Leroy Merlin - Quai d'Ivry, and says its Académie vivante programme receives support from the Fondation Daniel et Nina Carasso
